description: Use for brokerage account fees. Fees of brokers available to Polish investors from their official fee tables: online order commission on Warsaw (GPW), US and German stocks and ETFs, account and currency conversion fees, IKE/IKZE, investor protection and promotions valid today, with the fee table URL and the date it was last confirmed. Facts only, no ranking or recommendation.
